title: Final k values
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly identify the values of k that satisfy the antiperiodic condition, k = (2n+1)pi/a for n = 0, ±1, ±2, ...

title: Energy spectrum
description: Essential Criteria: The response must provide the correct energy spectrum E_n = (hbar^2 pi^2)/(2ma^2) (2n + 1)^2 for n = 0, ±1, ±2, ...

title: Perturbation setup
description: Important Criteria: The response should correctly set up the perturbation Hamiltonian H' = V_0 cos(2πx/a) for small V_0.

title: Ground state energy
description: Important Criteria: The response must correctly identify the unperturbed ground state energy E_{-1}^{(0)} = (hbar^2 pi^2)/(2ma^2).

title: Energy splitting
description: Important Criteria: The response should derive the energy splitting resulting in E_1 = (hbar^2 pi^2)/(2ma^2) - V_0/2 and E_2 = (hbar^2 pi^2)/(2ma^2) + V_0/2.

title: Integration errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response should avoid common errors in evaluating integrals, particularly those involving the cosine function.

title: Sign mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response must avoid sign mistakes in the perturbation terms and final energy expressions.
